node.statement: The map v supplied by lem-thmainext-conditional is an extended isomorphism, so v is bijective and every amplification v_n=id_{M_n} tensor v is bijective with inverse id_{M_n} tensor v^(-1). The extended-inclusion lower bound, enlarged as in the factor branch, is ||v_nX||>=(1-C_V*eta)||X||. Since (1.1) gives C_V*eta<=1/4, it follows that ||v_n^(-1)||<=1/(1-C_V*eta).
